user.title: Thermal zone
user.description: ATHB creates one Home Assistant device per thermal zone. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md)

data_description.name: Recognisable room or zone name used for the device and its entities.

environment.title: Room measurements
environment.description: Select the environmental inputs. Outdoor humidity is not used: adaptation depends on outdoor temperature history, while comfort and surface risk use indoor humidity. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#environmental-inputs)

data_description.primary_temperature: Representative room-air temperature. Invalid or stale input is never replaced with a plausible value.
data_description.rh_mode: Measured uses an entity; Declared uses a fixed percentage with declared provenance.
data_description.outdoor_source: Temperature source used to build the persisted seven-day running mean.

humidity.title: Indoor humidity
humidity.description: Only the input required by the selected humidity mode is shown. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#environmental-inputs)

data_description.rh_entity: Entity reporting indoor RH in percent.
data_description.rh_declared: Fixed indoor RH from 0 to 100%, explicitly tagged as declared.

targets.title: Climate targets
targets.description: Select one through eight climates. ATHB only sends temperature targets and never changes HVAC mode, power, fan, preset, swing or humidity. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#climate-targets)

data_description.targets: Thermostats whose supported temperature endpoint ATHB may manage.

preferences.title: Comfort and model choices
preferences.description: Balanced with a uniform radiant model is the recommended start. Enable advanced settings only for deliberate scientific or actuator tuning. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-strategy-and-profile)

data_description.comfort_strategy: Chooses the ATHB sensation vote solved for heating and cooling; it does not interpolate temperatures.
data_description.profile: Applies normal, Eco or temporary Boost policy after solving; Auto follows occupancy.
data_description.eco_intensity: How far Eco widens the solved adaptive target: Mild 2 °C, Workday 4 °C, Deep fixed inactive targets, or Custom offsets.
data_description.radiant_model: Uniform assumes MRT equals room air. Other choices reveal only required inputs.
data_description.advanced_settings: Walk through scientific assumptions, comfort bounds, command safety and local-air points.
data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional boolean or occupancy entity used only by Auto.

radiant.title: Radiant input
radiant.description: Only the source required by the chosen radiant model is shown. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#radiant-and-surface-models)

data_description.mrt_entity: True MRT; keep it physically distinct from air or surface temperature.
data_description.globe_temperature_entity: Globe temperature used to derive MRT.
data_description.globe_diameter_m: Globe diameter in metres; affects convective correction.
data_description.globe_emissivity: Long-wave emissivity of the globe coating.
data_description.surface_source: Measured uses a sensor; Modelled uses indoor/outdoor temperature and f_Rsi.

surface_details.title: Surface model
surface_details.description: Configure the cold surface and its bounded contribution to occupant MRT. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#radiant-and-surface-models)

data_description.surface_temperature_entity: Sensor on the inner surface; not room air or direct MRT.
data_description.surface_f_rsi: Factor in T_surface = T_outdoor + f_Rsi × (T_indoor - T_outdoor).
data_description.surface_view_factor: Fraction used to mix the surface into MRT; higher values increase influence.
data_description.surface_rh_threshold_pct: Diagnostic warning threshold; never commands humidity equipment.

advanced_model.title: Human and air-movement model
advanced_model.description: These assumptions directly affect the ATHB heat-balance sensation. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#human-and-air-movement-model)

data_description.met: Metabolic rate; 1 met = 58.15 W/m² and seated light work is about 1.1 met.
data_description.clothing_mode: Automatic derives adaptive clothing; Fixed uses a declared clo value.
data_description.air_speed_mode: Fixed uses declared m/s; Measured requires a valid entity.

clothing.title: Fixed clothing insulation
clothing.description: Use for a stable, known clothing ensemble. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#human-and-air-movement-model)

air_speed.title: Air speed
air_speed.description: Only the selected source is shown. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#human-and-air-movement-model)

data_description.air_speed_m_s: Fixed room air speed in m/s.
data_description.air_speed_entity: Entity in m/s; invalid or stale data blocks calculation instead of being replaced.

comfort_parameters.title: Comfort and adaptation bounds
comfort_parameters.description: Expert sensation and weather-memory values; these are not thermostat temperatures. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-and-adaptation-bounds)

data_description.lower_comfort_vote: Cold-side sensation boundary; more negative widens the cold side.
data_description.upper_comfort_vote: Warm-side sensation boundary; more positive widens the warm side.
data_description.running_mean_alpha: Exponential weight α; higher values retain older weather longer.
data_description.reject_extrapolation: Suppress roots outside ATHB 2022 applicability instead of flagging extrapolation.

profile_parameters.title: Eco and Boost profile tuning
profile_parameters.description: Only values used by the selected Eco intensity are shown. Policy is applied after strategy roots are solved. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#profile-tuning)

data_description.eco_heating_setback_c: Degrees subtracted from the solved heating root in Custom Eco.
data_description.eco_cooling_setback_c: Degrees added to the solved cooling root in Custom Eco.
data_description.inactive_heating_temperature: Direct room target used for heating in Deep Eco; final safety and device bounds still apply.
data_description.inactive_cooling_temperature: Direct room target used for cooling in Deep Eco; final safety and device bounds still apply.
data_description.boost_delta_c: Bounded shift toward comfort during Boost.
data_description.boost_duration_minutes: Maximum time before Boost ends automatically.

control_limits.title: Control limits and HVAC Auto mapping
control_limits.description: Hard command bounds and explicit interpretation of an existing Auto mode. ATHB still never changes HVAC mode. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#control-limits-and-auto-mapping)

data_description.minimum_control_temperature: Lowest °C request before intersecting device bounds.
data_description.maximum_control_temperature: Highest °C request before intersecting device bounds.
data_description.manual_override_minutes: Write suppression after an external target change, unless Resume is pressed.
data_description.auto_mapping: How hvac_mode=auto is treated; Unmapped is fail-safe and sends no command.

command_behavior.title: Command normalization and fallback
command_behavior.description: Expert inward rounding, redundant-write and missing-history controls. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#command-normalization-and-fallback)

data_description.minimum_range_gap: Required distance between heating and cooling in an atomic range command.
data_description.feedback_resolution: Tolerance comparing target feedback with the last ATHB command.
data_description.fallback_mode: Fixed uses declared targets; No write waits for qualified history.

fallback_temperatures.title: Fixed fallback temperatures
fallback_temperatures.description: Used only while outdoor history is insufficient. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#command-normalization-and-fallback)

data_description.fallback_heating_c: Fixed heating target within control bounds.
data_description.fallback_cooling_c: Fixed cooling target within bounds and above heating fallback.

critical_locations.title: Critical local-air locations
critical_locations.description: Add up to eight local-air points. Zero disables this feature. They use the selected strategy vote and bounded directional influence. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#critical-local-air-locations)

data_description.critical_location_count: Number of conditional local-air pages that follow.

critical_location.title: Critical location {number} of {total}
critical_location.description: Configure one separately measured local-air point. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#critical-local-air-locations)

data_description.location_id: Stable unique label such as window_seat.
data_description.location_mode: Monitoring does not constrain; Heating, Cooling or Both only affect selected directions.
data_description.location_entity: Local air temperature, not surface temperature or MRT.

target_calibration.title: Target calibration {number} of {total}
target_calibration.description: Actuator offset for `{target}`, not a room-sensor correction. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#target-calibration)

review.title: Review thermal zone
review.description:
**{zone}** will use `{primary}` and `{outdoor}` with {target_count} target(s). Strategy: **{strategy}**.

ATHB creates one zone device. Control starts **off** for a new zone until you enable it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure thermal zone
reconfigure.description: This repeats every setup choice while retaining the same zone identity and device. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md)

data_description.name: Update the displayed zone and device name.

error.invalid_rh_source: Select exactly one valid humidity source.
error.invalid_targets: Select one through eight distinct climate targets.
error.target_not_registered: Every climate target must have an entity-registry identity.
error.target_already_controlled: Another enabled ATHB zone already controls this target.
error.invalid_control_bounds: The minimum must be below the maximum.
error.invalid_option: One or more options are outside their supported range.
error.duplicate_location: Use a non-empty, unique location label.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The thermal zone configuration was updated successfully.

init.title: ATHB options
init.description: The same model settings offered during setup. Use Reconfigure for measurement sources and targets. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md)

data_description.comfort_strategy: ATHB sensation vote used for root solving.
data_description.eco_intensity: Mild widens 2 °C, Workday 4 °C, Deep uses inactive targets, and Custom uses expert offsets.
data_description.radiant_model: Uniform uses air temperature as MRT; other modes request only needed inputs.
data_description.advanced_settings: Open all expert settings in short conditional pages.

radiant.title: Radiant input
radiant.description: Only inputs required by the selected model. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#radiant-and-surface-models)

data_description.mrt_entity: True MRT, distinct from air and surface temperature.

surface_details.title: Surface model
surface_details.description: Cold-surface model and bounded MRT contribution. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#radiant-and-surface-models)

data_description.surface_f_rsi: Factor in the indoor/outdoor surface equation.

data_description.air_speed_entity: Measured m/s; invalid input blocks calculation.

profile_parameters.title: Eco and Boost profile tuning
profile_parameters.description: Only parameters used by the selected Eco intensity are shown. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#profile-tuning)

control_limits.title: Control limits and HVAC Auto mapping
control_limits.description: Hard bounds and interpretation of existing Auto mode. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#control-limits-and-auto-mapping)

data_description.auto_mapping: Unmapped sends no command in Auto.

command_behavior.title: Command normalization and fallback
command_behavior.description: Expert rounding, feedback and history controls. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#command-normalization-and-fallback)

critical_locations.title: Critical local-air locations
critical_locations.description: Zero through eight separate local-air points. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#critical-local-air-locations)

data_description.location_entity: Local air, not surface or MRT.

removed_source_or_target.title: ATHB source or target was removed
removed_source_or_target.description: Reconfigure the zone and select an available source or target.

duplicate_target_ownership.title: Climate target is controlled by two ATHB zones
duplicate_target_ownership.description: Disable one zone or select a different target.

corrupt_control_storage.title: ATHB control recovery data is corrupt
corrupt_control_storage.description: Review the zone and press Resume before enabling commands.

persistent_target_rejection.title: Climate target repeatedly rejected ATHB commands
persistent_target_rejection.description: Check the target capability, bounds and grid.

incompatible_auto_mapping.title: Automatic HVAC mode has no supported ATHB mapping
incompatible_auto_mapping.description: Configure an explicit supported mapping or select a supported HVAC mode.

missing_history_24h.title: ATHB outdoor history remains unavailable
missing_history_24h.description: Check the outdoor source and Recorder availability.

mandatory_input_unavailable_1h.title: A mandatory ATHB input remains unavailable
mandatory_input_unavailable_1h.description: Restore the selected temperature or humidity source.
